name: pi-tui-tests
description: Dependency scope for the interactive tier, shared by every package. Deliberately separate from any package's own node_modules: node_modules/@earendil-works/* there are symlinks into the container's global pi install, and an `npm install` at a package root would reify that tree and prune them. It sits next to pi-session.ts on purpose — that file is the only importer of these two packages, and node resolves them by walking up from the importing file, so a package's test files never need to see this scope at all.
